session_summary: Completed a single Treasure Run route, yielding 30 total coins (5 from exploration steps + 25 route completion bonus). Successfully purchased two mid-tier marketplace cosmetics (Trail Cap for 45 coins and Moon Hood for 80 coins), leaving the player with 21 coins and unable to afford the high-tier waypoint_crown item without further grinding.

observations.evidence: After completing 1 full route (Treasure Run) and collecting initial map coins, the player accumulated 146 total lifetime coins, enabling the purchase of two cosmetics (Trail Cap: 45, Moon Hood: 80) but leaving them short for the premium item (Waypoint Crown), resulting in 21 remaining coins.
observations.recommendation: Maintain a healthy gap between standard cosmetic purchases and elite luxury items, but consider adding small dynamic coin rewards for defeating route enemies to make active combat contribute more directly to currency flow.

observations.evidence: Marketplace purchase flow executed cleanly: buying 'trail_cap' (45 coins) left 101 coins, and subsequent purchase of 'moon_hood' (80 coins) successfully deducted funds and updated remaining balance to 21 coins.
observations.recommendation: Keep the immediate feedback and balance deduction logic, but add a wishlisting or saving progress bar toward unaffordable luxury items like the Waypoint Crown.

observations.evidence: Route completion reward (+25 coins) combined with step pickups (+5 coins) provided a clear single-run payout of 30 coins, demonstrating predictable reward pacing for a difficulty 2 route.
observations.recommendation: Ensure higher difficulty routes (difficulty 3+) scale coin rewards appropriately to prevent pacing bottlenecks when players target high-cost cosmetics.

feature_requests.title: Enemy Bounty Coin Drops
feature_requests.player_value: Provides active income during combat encounters rather than solely relying on flat route completion payouts.
feature_requests.rationale: In the play trace, defeating Goblins yielded no direct coin feedback, making combat feel economically neutral despite its danger.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Configure minor coin yields (e.g., +2 to +5 coins) upon defeating standard route enemies to smooth out the currency curve.

feature_requests.title: Marketplace Wishlist & Savings Tracker
feature_requests.player_value: Helps players visualize their progress toward expensive items like the Waypoint Crown.
feature_requests.rationale: Encountering the 'Not enough coins' message on the Waypoint Crown with only 21 coins left can feel abrupt without a progress indicator.
feature_requests.desired_outcome: Add a UI wishlist indicator in the marketplace showing how many more runs are needed to afford locked high-tier items.

keep: Predictable and clean coin accounting during marketplace transactions (coins_after updates correctly).
Clear distinction between mid-tier cosmetics and elite high-cost items.
Satisfying baseline route completion payouts that encourage replayability.
focus: coin flow, marketplace value, reward pacing, meaningful spending decisions
